title: Best Razor Blades (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on mentions in consumer reviews and product descriptions from consumerreports.org, gq.com, badgerandblade.com, and shavingadvisor.com.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so cost comparisons are omitted.

verdict.line: Picture a man who wants a close shave without the high cost of premium brands. Harry’s Plus Razor delivers a smooth, consistent cut and a comfortable grip, making it ideal for everyday use. Its main catch is that it may feel a bit heavier than some competitors.
